title: Heap Operations
definition: Heaps are stored as Flat Arrays. To insert: push to the end and 'Bubble Up' (O(log N)). To extract: swap root with the end, pop the end, and 'Bubble Down' (O(log N)).
simpleExplanation: When a new VIP arrives, they enter at the back of the line, and keep swapping places with the person in front of them until they reach the correct spot.
